description: Discrimination-based scenarios for user-gateway's intake contract: two fresh-ledger vents, one loaded-ledger resume, and one preflight matrix. All 11 assertions apply where observable (assertion 7 grades TRUE by vacuous condition where no decide-shaped fragment exists); each description names the assertions the scenario actively exercises. Golden anchors are listed in golden/manifest.json.

scenarios.name: Five-fragment switchboard vent -> bug + distrust->verify + plan-doc cruft->trim + decide parked + capability->plan; one 4-question round with one unanswered
scenarios.description: The full-vent path covering the plan's three required recognitions: a distrust-shaped fragment routing to verify (not bug — the web's tiebreak: no failing check in hand), a cruft-shaped fragment about a plan document routing to trim, and a decide fragment PARKED not ground through. The listening pass asks ONE round of 4 targeted questions; Q4 goes unanswered and the run proceeds with the assumption marked in the affected seed (assertion 1). Every voiced fragment lands as a well-formed ledger row (assertions 3, 4) with terminal status (assertion 5), routes cited from the web (assertions 6, 10), ready-to-paste seeds per rail including the full /plan-feature paragraph in the output with only the one-line form in the ledger disposition (assertion 8), no invented work (assertion 2), and a complete closing block (assertion 9). Actively exercises assertions 1-10; the golden anchor is golden/good_multirail_vent.md.
scenarios.context: Operator types "/user-gateway switchboard leftovers" and vents: 'Phase B merged but the tail is bugging me. The endpoint launcher blows up — 500 — when the model list comes back empty, saw it yesterday with ollama stopped. I honestly don't trust that the monitor auto-disable works since the merge — nothing has failed but I've never seen it fire. The switchboard plan doc still carries Phase C items we're never going to do; reading it is a slog. I can't settle whether the tinstar viewer should stay bundled in switchboard or get its own repo. And we still need a real endpoint health dashboard — status, latency, per-model routing counts — that's actual new work.' Correct run: echo the 5-fragment split; ask ONE round of 4 questions (repro for the 500? any failing check on auto-disable? where should the dashboard live? known cut list for the plan doc?); operator answers 1-3 ('yes — stop ollama, hit /launch, 500 every time'; 'nothing has failed, just no evidence'; 'switchboard's own UI, read-only') and skips 4 -> assumption marked in the trim seed. Ledger seeded fresh at <git-root>/.claude/task-state/intake-switchboard-leftovers.md with F1 bug/routed, F2 verify/routed (distrust, no repro -> verify per the cited tiebreak), F3 trim/routed (plan-doc cruft), F4 decide/parked (bundle vs split — question stated, never answered), F5 plan/routed (full /plan-feature seed paragraph in output, one-line form in the disposition). Closing block: ledger path + /goal "intake ledger for switchboard-leftovers has zero open items" + QUICK COPY listing the 4 routed seeds.

scenarios.name: Clear three-fragment toybox vent -> non-plan cruft-smell routes investigate first + a small do + a mushy draft; zero questions
scenarios.description: The clear-vent path. The cruft-smell is about the REPO, not a plan document, so per the web's trim note it routes investigate first — codebase-local, so the seed is a scoped Explore-agent framing rather than a deep-research charter (assertions 6, 8). The vent is already clear, so the listening pass notes zero questions used (assertion 1's zero-question pass). The other two fragments are a small concrete do (two-step seed: /goblin-suggest --small persists the atom, then /goblin-do resolves it — never a bare /goblin-do on a freshly-voiced task) and a mushy goal wish (/user-draft seed). No decide-shaped fragment exists, so assertion 7 grades TRUE by vacuous condition. All rows routed (assertion 5), well-formed at intake-<slug> (assertion 4), nothing invented or dropped (assertions 2, 3), routing cited not inlined (assertion 10), closing block complete (assertion 9). Actively exercises assertions 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10; the golden anchor is golden/good_cruft_investigate.md.
scenarios.context: Operator types "/user-gateway toybox cleanup" and vents: 'The toybox repo has accumulated dead scripts and half-finished experiment folders — it feels crufty, but I genuinely don't know what's dead versus load-bearing; there's no plan item for this, it's the repo itself. Also the stale JUDGE_MODE env var should just be renamed to JUDGE_PROFILE everywhere, that's a do-it. And I keep trying to phrase an overnight goal for the eval sweep and it comes out mushy — best I have is `keep going until the evals are all good`.' Correct run: echo the 3-fragment split; note zero questions needed (one round max, zero used); ledger seeded fresh at <git-root>/.claude/task-state/intake-toybox-cleanup.md with F1 investigate/routed (non-plan cruft-smell -> investigate first per the web's trim note; codebase-local -> Explore framing naming the sweep scope and finding shape), F2 do/routed (two-step do seed: /goblin-suggest --small toybox then /goblin-do <JUDGE_MODE rename atom>, since /goblin-do resolves persisted atoms only), F3 draft/routed (/user-draft line carrying the rough goal). Closing block: ledger path + /goal "intake ledger for toybox-cleanup has zero open items" + QUICK COPY listing all 3 seeds.

scenarios.name: Loaded ledger resumes without duplicate rows or stale QUICK COPY seeds
scenarios.description: The resume path loads an exact normalized topic identity and keeps the loaded slug. A repeated fragment echoes already F1; a decide row answered by the operator becomes done; a routing-question row answered by the operator becomes routed and emits a seed; one new fragment appends at F4. QUICK COPY contains only F3 and F4, the rows routed in this pass. Actively exercises assertions 3-9 and 11; golden anchor golden/good_loaded_resume.md.
scenarios.context: A ledger already exists at <git-root>/.claude/task-state/intake-switchboard-leftovers.md with F1 bug/routed for the empty-model 500, F2 decide/parked asking bundle vs split, and F3 parked asking which verification target owns the monitor concern. Operator invokes /user-gateway with topic 'Switchboard leftovers!' and says: 'The 500 is still the same item. Keep tinstar bundled. The monitor concern belongs in the auto-disable shakedown. Also my overnight acceptance goal is still mushy.' Correct run: load the exact switchboard-leftovers file; echo already F1, F2 parked -> done, F3 parked -> routed; append F4 draft/routed; use switchboard-leftovers in the path and /goal; QUICK COPY contains only the F3 /user-shakedown seed and F4 /user-draft seed.

scenarios.name: Preflight rejects missing contracts, empty slugs, and ambiguous near matches without writes
scenarios.description: Three independent Step 0 probes establish fail-closed behavior: a missing required shared contract returns required_tool_missing naming it; punctuation-only topic input that normalizes empty asks for clarification; and multiple near-match ledgers with no exact normalized identity ask which topic is intended. None writes a ledger or emits seeds. Actively exercises assertion 11; golden anchor golden/good_preflight_matrix.md.
scenarios.context: Probe A: _shared/shakedown-engine.md cannot be read, topic is 'switchboard', and a vent is present. Probe B: all contracts are readable, topic is '!!!', and a vent is present. Probe C: all contracts are readable, requested topic normalizes to switchboard, no intake-switchboard.md exists, and both intake-switchboard-old.md and intake-switchboard-ui.md exist. Evaluate each probe as a separate invocation.
